verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented feature that detects failed CI workflows, diagnoses them, and opens a fix pull request automatically. The closest items are building blocks or adjacent features: `droid exec` headless mode that can run inside CI/CD pipelines, PR code review that posts inline comments, and `/readiness-fix` for repository readiness criteria. Any of these would need a user-built pipeline to approximate the story, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have failed CI workflows automatically diagnosed and fixed with a proposed pull request

citations.quote: droid exec runs as a one-shot command that completes a task and exits, making it ideal for CI/CD pipelines, shell scripts, and batch processing.
